description.en: OpenSafeIntent is a benchmark of controlled prompt-sets that vary user intent while holding the underlying task fixed. Each datapoint contains benign, dual-use, and malicious variants of the same task, and models are evaluated on whether they calibrate assistance across intent shifts rather than only appearing safe on average.
